storyCards.headline: Sail On: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Commodores's "Sail On" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Sail On" is a Commodores song written by Lionel Richie from their 1979 album Midnight Magic.

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "All The Greatest Hits" (1982) — not the song's original release year.
